name: Task_2
description:
Prepare sodium silicate using the original cooling and hold protocol. Start from the supplied molten sodium silicate state at 4000 K in /workspace/structures/melt/liq4000.dat, using read_data. Use the supplied BKS-type Buckingham-Coulomb potential with PPPM electrostatics in LAMMPS, real units, charge atom style, periodic boundaries, and isotropic NPT at zero target pressure. Preserve the supplied atoms, cell, charges, and velocities; do not initialize velocities or reset the step count. Use a 1 fs timestep and 100 fs thermostat damping.

Cool continuously from 4000 K to 300 K at 10 K/ps for 370 ps (370,000 steps), with pressure damping of 10,000 fs. Then hold at 300 K for 100 ps (100,000 steps), with pressure damping of 5000 fs. For example, use `fix cooling all npt temp 4000 300 100 iso 0 0 10000` and `run 370000`, then unfix cooling, define the hold integrator, and `run 100000`. Equivalent split runs that preserve the temperature schedule are allowed. Unfix each completed stage integrator before defining the next.

The complete preparation requires 470,000 advancing steps, with boundaries at steps 0, 370,000, and 470,000. Record stage, step, elapsed time in ps, target and measured temperature, pressure, and density at sufficient resolution to reproduce the analysis, including each stage endpoint. Time and step count start at zero. Keep restartable states at the initial state, cooling end, hold start, and hold end, preserving the cell, atom IDs, species, positions, charges, velocities, and elapsed time. Save the input and raw log files. Carry the same system through all stages without replacing atoms or reinitializing velocities.
submission_format: Submit the path to your completed manifest.json file. Use the blank example as a guide and fill in the required fields for this task. Paths inside the manifest may be relative to the manifest file.
